name: shadcn/vue
summary: VS Code extension that installs shadcn-vue components and adds cn/cni/cnx snippet completions in Vue files.
description: Initializes the shadcn/vue CLI, installs one or several shadcn/vue components from a list, and opens the documentation or a particular component's docs page. Snippets add imports with cni-[component] and template markup with cnx-[component] in .vue files.
contains: install shadcn/vue components from the editor
open docs or a component's doc page from the editor
